analysis.label: CareerPath Analysis
analysis.disclaimer: CareerPath analysis is our interpretation of published and observed market data. It is not an official government assessment.
insights: Local economic inactivity drivers differ materially, so programme design needs to be interpreted through place-based evidence.
Existing health, skills and community provision can create both partnership opportunities and duplication risk.
Learning from trailblazer delivery can inform future commissioning and local employment-support strategy.
